theorem Roth.one_le_lem6M : ∀ (p r₁ : ℕ) {B : ℝ}, 1 ≤ B → ∀ (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ Roth.lem6M p r₁ B l :=
fun p r₁ {B} hB l ↦
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ 1 ≤ _a) (Roth.lem6M.eq_1 p r₁ B l)))
    (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
      (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le
        (one_le_mul_of_one_le_of_one_le (one_le_pow₀ (le_add_of_nonneg_left (Nat.cast_nonneg r₁)))
          (cast
            (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LE.le (Eq.symm Nat.cast_one)) ↑l.factorial) Nat.cast_le._simp_1))
            (Nat.factorial_pos l)))
        (one_le_pow₀ hB))
      (one_le_pow₀
        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl true))))
ONELEM6M200_FULL_TYPE: ∀ (p r₁ : ℕ) {B : ℝ}, 1 ≤ B → ∀ (l : ℕ), 1 ≤ Roth.lem6M p r₁ B l
